propositions: CLI command identity and policy are reconstructed through overlapping frozensets, intercept tables, and regex-based reference generation, creating parser/help drift and maintenance burden
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help; `rebar help <command>` reports them unknown while handler-owned `--help` is inconsistent and can execute work
Parser grammar must be sourced from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used by both runtime handlers and build-time generation
Help and unknown-command output must read committed package-help bytes before operation/config/mount/handler resolution, with no docs-only parser or second grammar authority
Exact command aliases (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard) must reuse canonical grammar/help; hidden bridge-status must be helpable but undiscoverable; purge-bridge remains unknown
CLI reference generation, coverage checks, and wheel validation must enumerate registries and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses
